label: Commit search
placeholder: Search commits: message, author or SHA
hint: Searches message, author and SHA (from 4 characters) of all branches and tags – including beyond the loaded rows.
filtersHint: Narrow it with code:text (added or removed code), path:src/app, since:2026-01-01 or until:2026-06-30.
empty: No commit matches “{{query}}”. The search covered message, author and SHA of all branches and tags. Accented characters must be written exactly as in the commit.
limit: More than {{limit}} matches – showing the first {{limit}}. A more specific search term narrows it down.
